text:
ajay: Heads-up — saw duplicates in the onboarding sample app when requests hit 429 during token refresh. Node SDK retries; Go SDK cancels+replays. Repro below.

ajay: Repro steps:
1) Start streaming chat
2) Force token refresh mid-stream -> upstream returns 429
3) client retries automatically
4) duplicate DB side-effect observed

ajay: snippet:
```
// node sampleapp snippet
await client.chat.stream({ conversationId })
// on 429, SDK retries without idempotency-key for side-effect events
```

maria-lopez: Oof. Is this only for streaming or normal REST writes too?

samir: Seen this pattern in both, but streaming makes it trickier because state is rehydrated. Node backoff uses deterministic jitter seed=0, Go uses crypto-rand jitter. That means retries line up differently across SDKs.

olivia: Do we have a parity doc for jitter seeding + retry semantics? I thought we locked that down.

cheng-wu: We have a parity doc but it focuses on sync RPCs. Streaming resume handshake is not documented. We require 'Idempotency-Key' for create endpoints, but streaming chunk events often bypass it.

ajay: Quick mitigation proposal: on token-refresh-triggered 429, surface a special error code (e.g. "retryable_no_replay") so app-level code can decide. Longer-term: add `x-replay-safe: true` header for ops safe to replay.

samir: Also add small random jitter to retry-after parsing: sleep = base + rand(0, base*0.1) so clients don't retry in lockstep during rotations.

maria-lopez: For onboarding, update sampleapp to set Idempotency-Key at the HTTP wrapper layer for any DB-affecting action. That teaches best practice.

olivia: Yes — and add a lint rule in sampleapp that fails CI if an example calls a write endpoint without an idempotency key.

retry-bot: deploy queued: devex/sampleapp-idempotency-lint v1 -> staging at 1962345800 :rocket:

ajay: I'll open a PR so Node SDK will attach `x-client-replay-hash` (hash of last acked op). Go SDK will match parity in the same PR set. PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/88>

cheng-wu: Also add docs blurb: "When using streaming, prefer application-level idempotency for side-effecting actions; treat token refresh as opaque to avoid unsafe replay."

samir: +1. Can we add an e2e test that simulates token rotation + 429 and asserts once-only semantics for writes?

maria-lopez: I'll own the e2e test. tagging @olivia to update sampleapp lint and docs.

olivia: On it — will add lint rule, doc snippet, and an example showing header usage.

ajay: Thanks. Filing follow-ups: SDK parity checklist item, sampleapp lint PR, and a telemetry event "unsafe_replay_detected" to help us find regressions.

maria-lopez: Nice. Small ask — can the telemetry include original idempotency key (hash) so we can correlate across SDKs?

ajay: Yep, we'll send only a hash. No PII.

samir: Great. End-to-end plan: 1) sampleapp lint + docs, 2) Node+Go SDK parity PRs, 3) e2e test and telemetry, 4) staging verification.

ajay: Thanks everyone — will coordinate PRs and post updates here.
